item.title: Letter: Unfair workers’ comp laws
item.description: Letter: A workers’ comp policy can cost more than many of these small contractors earn in a year. As a result, more than 80–90% of small construction businesses in southern Missouri are technically out of compliance. Not because they’re dishonest. Not because they’re unsafe. But because they’re poor. The post Letter: Unfair workers’ comp laws appeared first on Houston Herald.
